# A marker with nothing to place

This document carries a placement marker but no index marks at all. There is
no index to place, which is reported, and the marker itself must leave no
element behind in any format.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

Prose after the marker, so its removal is visible as an absence rather than
as the end of the document.
